label: There is no infinite chain in which each member is moved in local MOTION_2 by the…, from contact
meaning: Physics VII.1's repaired regress (242b23-243a2), typed over chains of beings, with the contact condition as its own premise (audit B #388, open item). Not a transcription: the contact premise is instantiated at every link to build the touching chain, and premisesNeeded shows each of the four premises is needed. Restricted to local, bodily motion and primary moved movers, as the source is. Connects results; closes nothing.

strong_version_needed.9a36bdc4-75a6-5c39-9d70-88bd42ba38a5: The frozen original source-generalized proof interface consumes unrestricted touching-chain composition. It is retained as that existing argument, not a claim of global necessity: LOCAL-COMPOSITION-SUFFICES-FOR-EXISTING-CONTACT-REGRESS reaches the EXACT same conclusion with the weaker local-chain composition premise and the three unchanged contact/traversal/impossibility premises. The old stronger theorem itself does not accept the weaker input.
